reuse.why: Routes every expected-amount computation (preview, posting, action sync, forecast, schedule template, API list and UI) through the existing exported getScheduledAmount, and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules for the tolerance.

duplication.why: Removes five inline midpoint copies; the worst-case rule exists once in shared/schedules.ts.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts beside the other schedule helpers; the API only adds a field computed by that helper.

scope.why: Focused on the amount rule and the API field; the many UI call-site edits are needed only to thread the operator.

maintainability.why: One definition owns the rule, but callers now pass a positional 'false' inverse flag plus an op string, an awkward signature that is easy to call wrong (useScheduleEdit still omits op).

bypasses_abstraction.where: No remaining site computes a ranged amount itself; all call getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies are deleted and replaced by calls to the shared helper.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts gains an op parameter and an isapprox branch, both part of the general rule; all callers in loot-core and desktop-client use it.
